evidence.title: Vue Bits - Animated UI Components - Made with Vue.js

name: Vue Bits
summary: Free animated Vue.js UI component collection: animations, backgrounds and interactive effects customized with props.
description: Vue Bits is a large collection of animated Vue UI components — animations, components and backgrounds — free to use and customized through props. It is the official Vue port of React Bits. This Made with Vue.js listing links its GitHub repo and its own website.
